messages:
Maya (CS): FYI NexaCloud just tripped our budget alert for embeddings. Spike looks sustained since last night. QBR prep in 10 days so we need a short mitigation + narrative. Anyone with quick diagnostics?

Omar (FinOps): I'm pulling the per-endpoint ledger now. Early read: bulk import job + very large embedding vectors. Rough burn +250% vs baseline.

Zoe (AE): They're on a free-tier contract nearing renewal. CTO mentioned a one-off dataset migration yesterday. They sound sensitive to invoice surprises.

Ravi (EngOps): From logs: import-worker-3 retried the batch 6x due to transient 503s, so double-counting happened. Opening infra ticket.

Maya (CS): Two-pronged action: (A) short-term safeguards for spend and UX, (B) QBR talking points + ask. Proposals: soft rate limit on embed endpoint, auto-dedupe retries at edge, offer a one-time goodwill credit capped at $10k, and a post-migration review session.

Omar (FinOps): Soft rate limit OK. Credit needs Finance sign-off; I can greenlight up to $5k today. For the QBR I'll prepare a 2-slide "what happened" + 6-week forecast showing projected burn if imports continue.

Billing Bot: Alert: account=nexacloud reached 92% of monthly budget. Event ts=2141113300. Suggested actions: apply-rate-limit, open-support-ticket.

Zoe (AE): I'll tell the customer we're running a temporary rate limit to prevent surprise bills. Also offering a 30-min post-migration enablement call. Will present renewal as "risk if pattern repeats" but open to a commitment conversation.

Ravi (EngOps): Quick mitigation deployed: edge dedupe patch + retry-backoff. Patch command used: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/import-worker -n prod` . Monitoring errors.

Maya (CS): Can someone paste the 7d usage deltas here? Need percent deltas for QBR.

Omar (FinOps): Pasted: 7d embeddings tokens: [day-6:+12%, day-5:+9%, day-4:+15%, day-3:+220%, day-2:+260%, day-1:+275%, today:+240%]. I'll convert to a sparkline for the slide.

Zoe (AE): Customer response: CTO appreciated the quick fix. They're open to a migration to Dedicated if we can show 20-30% unit cost savings on embeddings. Wants numbers at QBR.

Maya (CS): Action list (owners): Omar - 2-slide cost incident + 6wk forecast; Ravi - confirm retry dedupe stable and share postmortem; Zoe - confirm renewal window & send invite for enablement; CS - craft QBR narrative and risk ladder. Due: 48hrs.

Omar (FinOps): Draft numbers: if imports keep repeating, projected overage = ~$27k next month. Dedicated + quantized embeddings could reduce unit cost ~25% in our model. I'll add scenarios (no change, mitigation only, migrate).

Ravi (EngOps): Error rate down to 1.2% from 8% after patch. CPU briefly maxed but autoscaled. Link to incident log: https://internal/incidents/nexacloud/2141113001

Maya (CS): Thanks. Zoe please let me know when the customer accepts the enablement time. Also tagging @finance for final credit approval.

Zoe (AE): Enablement scheduled Thu 11am PT. I told them about the credit cap pending sign-off.

Billing Bot: Credit request queued: account=nexacloud amount=$5000 status=pending finance_approval. request_ts=2141114500.

Maya (CS): Final note for QBR: emphasize root cause (import retry storm), short-term controls (rate limit + dedupe), medium-term options (Dedicated + quantization), and a proposed customer goodwill gesture. Keep slides concise.

Omar (FinOps): I'll upload the slide images to the QBR deck by EOD. If finance approves the $5k credit we'll include line item.

Ravi (EngOps): Keeping the incident ticket open and will post any regressions here.

Maya (CS): Great work team. We'll review the slides in the prep sync tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
